Base directory for this skill: D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime\.claude\skills\aliasbreaker

Run one AliasBreaker campaign following the protocol in CLAUDE.md exactly.

- CASE = the fixture path given in the arguments (e.g.
  `../data/cases/dev/case-101.json`).
- RUN = `runs/<run-id>` if a run id was given, else `runs/<case-id>-manual`.

Begin with `start`, follow the decision guidance, and end with `finalize`.
All hard rules in CLAUDE.md apply unchanged.


ARGUMENTS: ../data/cases/dev/case-112.json runs/dev-v2-case-112-r1

cd "D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime" && python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/dev-v2-case-112-r1 --slot 7 --why "Only pairs 0-2, 0-3, 2-3 remain live with 2-3 strongest, slot at t=44.11 is the earliest reachable slot resolving 0-3 at the capped 4-sigma level while also giving near 3-sigma separation on 2-3, preserving cursor for later slots if needed"

cd "D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime" && python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/dev-v2-case-112-r1 --slot 40 --why "Candidate 2 leads at 0.95 support just under theta, the only live pair is 0 vs 2 and diagnostics show only one remaining slot with separation above 2-sigma for this pair, so a confirmation jump to t=84.51 for the near-4-sigma separation is justified rather than staying with an uninformative early slot"

cd "D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime" && python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/dev-v2-case-112-r1 --slot 42 --why "Candidate 2 sits at 0.9966 support just under theta of 0.997 with candidate 0 the only remaining rival, slot at t=87.27 is the best available remaining separation at 3.48-sigma for this pair and is the final budgeted observation"

content.text: Support for candidate 2 now at 0.999918, above theta=0.997. Finalizing.

content.text:
Campaign complete for **case-112**.

- **Resolved:** candidate index 2, period ≈ 11.24 days
- **Final support:** 0.999918 (θ = 0.997)
- **Observations used:** 6 / 6

Path: started with 6 candidates roughly split between short-period aliases and the true ~11.2-day orbit; slot 1 (t=36.23) knocked out candidates 1 and 4; slot 4 (t=40.25) and slot 7 (t=44.11) narrowed the field to {0, 2, 3}; slot 14 (t=53.59) collapsed candidate 3 and pushed candidate 2 to 0.95; two confirmation observations (slots 40 and 42, both deep jumps justified by diagnostics showing the 0-vs-2 discriminating power was sparse and late) closed the gap from 0.9966 to 0.9999, crossing θ on the final budgeted observation.
